text: On the bundle theory, the properties (or tropes) that make up a single concrete object are held together by the relation of ___, roughly co-location in the same region.
explanation: Compresence is the relation that binds a bundle of co-located properties or tropes into one object. The compresence problem is that treating compresence as itself a further trope threatens a regress, which is why bundle theorists often take it as a primitive formal relation.
